topic: How one Oman retail company cut payroll prep from three days to two hours after switching to WPS-integrated payroll
format: Open with a SmartPRO Hub product capability, then show the real-world business outcome it enables
post:
SmartPRO Hub's WPS payroll integration doesn't automate salary transfers. It kills the three-day scramble that happens before them.

One retail company in Oman was burning 72 hours every payroll cycle — chasing timesheets, cross-checking bank details, hand-formatting WPS files, and hoping nothing bounced back from the bank.

After switching to SmartPRO Hub: two hours.

Same team. Same payroll complexity. Different system.

What actually changed? Attendance data feeds straight into payroll. WPS files generate automatically, already formatted for direct bank submission. Compliance checks run in the background — no separate spreadsheet, no last-minute audit before you hit send.

Finance gets their Friday back. HR stops being the bottleneck. And nobody's running payroll on pure anxiety anymore.

What Oman businesses actually need isn't another tool to babysit. It's one place where the data is already sitting there when payday comes.

If payroll prep is still eating days, that's not a people problem. It's a process problem.
